title: Khloe Kardashian's Over-the-Top Holiday Home Transformation Needs to Be Seen to Be Believed
text:
See Khloe Kardashian's "Absolutely Spectacular" Holiday Lights on Her House 
 News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Khloe Kardashian's Over-the-Top Holiday Home Transformation Needs to Be Seen to Be Believed
 Khloe Kardashian gave fans a look at the "fairy tale-esque" Christmas lights that the Kardashians star decked out her home with: "Everything is so magical." 
 By Brahmjot Kaur Nov 10, 2026 3:25 PM | Updated 19 hours ago Tags Celebrity Families Christmas Kardashian News Home Holidays Celebrities Khloe Kardashian Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Kim Kardashian, Khloe Kardashian Share Glimpses Into Mom Kris Jenner’s 71st Birthday Celebration Khloe Kardashian is keeping up with the holiday spirit . 
 After all, the Kardashians star shared a glimpse into the "razzle and dazzle" from the thousands of Christmas lights adorning her Los Angeles home this season.  
 "I love the holidays for so many reasons, but when there are twinkle lights everywhere, it's amazing," Kardashian began in her Nov. 9 Instagram Story. "I love. And then these hedges are lined with lights. Everything is so magical." 
 All the trees and bushes along her curved driveway were decorated with bright lights leading to her home, which sat beside a decked-out massive oak tree with a swing. She praised, "It is like razzle and dazzle." 
 As for what lighting style the reality star—who shares kids True , 8, and Tatum , 4, with ex Tristan Thompson —went for? 
 "I love when my house is gingerbread style, so basically, you trim the perimeter of things," she explained, noting how bright the area was now. "It's so crazy what this does, how peaceful and fairy tale-esque and gorgeous these lights make this. It is absolutely spectacular, and I could not be any happier." 
 read Kim Kardashian, Khloe Kardashian Share Glimpses Into Mom Kris Jenner’s 71st Birthday Celebration Though Kardashian has continued to prove that she's always doing the holidays amazing, sweetie, she credits Kris Jenner —mom to kids Khloe, Kourtney Kardashian , Kim Kardashian and Rob Kardashian Jr. , with ex Robert Kardashian Sr. , as well as Kendall Jenner and Kylie Jenner with ex Caitlyn Jenner —with their traditions. 
 "When I think of Christmas, you are the holidays, any holiday," she said to the matriarch on her Khloe in Wonder Land podcast in December 2025. “It could be like Presidents' Day. Every morning, that was a significant thing. You were like, 'Happy Presidents' Day!' There would be a napkin and something cute in our lunchbox." 
 The mom of two had followed suit when she got older, adding, "That's something that I definitely copy and paste from you. And I love it." 
 Khloe Kardashian/Instagram From decorations and desserts to presents and parties, Jenner had always prioritized celebrating the holidays. 
 "I remember all of our Christmas Eve parties, but not necessarily one over the other," Kardashian, 42, recalled. "It's just the tradition and the consistency of them that's so safe and nostalgic and comforting. I think it's so important that you've created those safe spaces for us." 
 "It can be so silly, but what that does for those core memories at home, how that makes you feel and the safety of it," she added. “I want to emulate that and mirror that in my life." 
 While the Kardashian-Jenners prepare for the holidays, keep reading for a look back at last year's celebrations. 
 Instagram Sibling Moment
 Kylie Jenner 's kids Stormi , 7, and Aire , 3, shared a sweet cuddle while all dressed up on Christmas Eve.
 Instagram Rockin' Around
 Kylie's son Aire was having a blast at their family party.
 Instagram Holiday Jewels
 Kylie showed off her new jewelry on Dec. 27, including the Cartier Panther pendant paved with diamonds ( $30,500 ).
 Instagram Matching Gifts
 Atiana De La Hoya gifted stepparents Kourtney Kardashian and Travis Barker matching Goyard passport covers that she hand-painted with Mickey and Minnie Mouse motifs.
 Instagram Keeping Cozy
 Kourtney shared a look at her living room after opening presents, writing, "I love a Christmas mess."
 Instagram Like Father, Like Son
 Travis revealed 2-year-old Rocky Barker 's new spiked shoes from his own Vans design collaboration, bearing the words "Dues Paid."
 Khloe Kardashian/Instagram A Puppy for Christmas
 Khloe Kardashian shared her paw-fect Christmas gift to her kids.
 Instagram ...And 4 More
 Kim Kardashian surprised her four kids  North West ,  Saint West , Chicago West and Psalm West  with four puppies, one for each of them.
 Instagram/Atiana De La Hoya 
 Timothée Chalamet Makes His Debut 
 In a subtle but major way, Timothée Chalamet earned a spot on the family's infamous gingerbread house next to girlfriend Kylie.
 Khloe Kardashian/Instagram Elf Not on the Shelf
 Khloe posted a photo of an elf entertaining the kids at their family Christmas Eve party.
 Khloe Kardashian/Instagram Santa Claus is Coming to Town
 Khloe shared a sweet photo of kids True and Tatum posing with Santa at their family Christmas Eve gathering.
 Kim Kardashian/Instagram Dressed to the Nines
 For their annual Christmas Eve gathering, Kim wore a Thierry Mugler from from the 1986 Hiver Russe Collection. While the family has opted for a smaller family affair the past two years, that doesn't mean they don't still show up in style. "We're doing a really family intimate one that I'm really excited about," Kim told Vogue in 2024. "Still dressing up to the nines, because that's what we do."
 Christmas Cookie Time
 Khloe and True made chewy Christmas cookies together to get in the holiday spirit, as Khloe shared on Instagram Dec. 24. True gave a full tutorial on how to make the festive treat with some help from her mom, who True decided was the perfect baking partner. When the cookies came out of the oven, True shared, "The cookies smell so good, I wish you could smell them from the camera."
 Instagram Raising a Glass
 Kourtney's stepdaughter Alabama Barker marked her 20th birthday on Christmas Eve, giving a glimpse at the celebrations.
 Instagram Bringing the North Pole to Calabasas
 Alabama got to experience real penguins at home on Dec. 24.
 Instagram/Kim Kardashian Fabulous Flannel 
 Kim shared how she wrapped her Christmas gifts in Skims flannel this year, which she noted North picked out. Kim even showed off how her pajamas were the exact same fabric in the Dec. 23 post: "It's actually so cute, I'm wearing it right now."
 Instagram Feline Fine
 Kylie debuted her annual 2025 Christmas wrapping, this time opting for a bold leopard print. As she put it, "Was feeling fun this year."
 Instagram Yule Be Sorry
 Kim struggled to get kids North, Saint, Chicago and Psalm into a family photo ahead of Christmas, quipping on Instagram Dec. 22, "I really tried."
 Instagram Happiest Time of Year
 Khloe took the next generation of Kar-Jenner to the Happiest Place on Earth, posting a selfie with her kids True and Tatum as well as their cousins Dream Kardashian , Chicago and Psalm. Khloe captioned the Dec. 22 snap, "Disneyland with my elves."
 Instagram/@ChefBae Menu Revealed
 Kourtney and Travis celebrated the holidays early with their blended family—which includes Kourtney's kids Mason ,  Penelope , and Reign , as well as Travis' son Landon , daughter Alabama and stepdaughter Atiana, in addition to their son Rocky. 
 Celebrity chef  Brooke   Baevsky prepared a citrus pear and fennel salad, herby chicken meatballs, plant-based pumpkin chickpea cakes, roasted Japanese sweet potatoes, high-protein mac and cheese and grain-free dairy-free chocolate chip cookies—plus gluten-free gingerbread cookies at the placesettings.
 Instagram What Goes Around
 Kourtney gave a glimpse into the carousel-themed decor.
